latin: Sensibilia communia proprias species ad sensus multiplicant, distinctas a speciebus sensibilium propriorum.
translation: The common sensibles send their own species to the senses, species distinct from those of the proper sensibles.
translation_note: 'sensibilia communia'/'sensibilium propriorum' kept as 'common sensibles'/'proper sensibles', the standard Aristotelian pair; cf. 10.3 and farmer1998:14035.
